\section[\texorpdfstring{\ar{استقال} (istaqāla)}{استقال (istaqāla)}]{\ar{استقال} (istaqāla) — to resign}

\label{lesson:AR-C195-istaqala}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Arabic for to smell, then the Arabic for to hold.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ar{استقال}}
\textbf{\ar{استقال}} — \emph{istaqāla} — \textquotedblleft{}to resign\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ar{استقال}} (\emph{istaqāla}) is built on the native Arabic root \emph{q-y-l}, \textquotedblleft{}to cancel a bargain\textquotedblright{} (Lane). \emph{Istaqāla} is Form X, \textquotedblleft{}to ask to be released\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Arabic for to smell, then the Arabic for to hold, then say \emph{istaqāla} again
